text: A mighty lion was sleeping under a big tree.
A tiny mouse ran across his paw by mistake.
pages.alt: The mouse runs over the sleeping lion

text: The lion woke with a roar and caught the mouse.
"Please let me go!" squeaked the mouse.
"How could a mouse ever help a lion?" he said.
But he lifted his paw and let her go.
pages.alt: The lion lets the mouse go

text: A few days later, hunters set a strong rope net in the forest.
The lion walked right into it.
pages.alt: The lion is caught in a net

text: The lion roared and pulled, but the ropes held tight.
All the animals in the forest heard him.
pages.alt: The lion roars and the forest listens

text: The little mouse heard him too.
She ran as fast as she could to find the lion.
pages.alt: The mouse runs through the forest

text: She chewed the ropes with her sharp little teeth, one by one.
pages.alt: The mouse chews through the ropes

text: "You were kind to me, so I am glad I could help you," said the mouse.
From then on, the two were friends.
pages.alt: The lion and the mouse are friends
